mechanism: Admit exact R4, packed R0, and device-native BF16 expert projections into the persistent selected-route lease; validate supported kinds on device; dispatch per lease; and bind exact representation/extent metadata to the immutable route for hit accounting without an ID or metrics readback.

scope.persistent_route_policy: one selected route plus one shared triplet per sparse layer

admission.r4: D32/S1/sub32/card256/bits8 with exact rows, columns, packed extent, and four-byte tail padding
admission.r0: D8/S1/sub8/card128/bits7 with exact rows, columns, packed extent, and four-byte tail padding
admission.native_bf16: row-major device buffer at least rows*cols*2 bytes with no secondary pointer

dispatch.pq_only_lease: One established indirect PQ dispatch per projection.
dispatch.native_only_lease: One sequential native-BF16 indirect dispatch per projection.
dispatch.heterogeneous_lease: Paired PQ/native dispatches; exactly one handles the descriptor kind and the other returns without writing.
dispatch.validation_required_kind: PQ, native-BF16, or any-supported according to the routed lease mode

route_bound_accounting.principle: A hit can only select ready entries in the last immutable selected-route snapshot. The exact per-projection kind, bytes, rows, columns, and PQ parameters captured after the prior guarded miss are therefore exact hit metadata.

fail_closed_evidence.mutation: up projection kind changed to unsupported 99

qualified: Persistent selected-route hits may contain any exact mixture of R4, R0, and native-BF16 projections.
Routed and shared leases select dispatch modes independently.
R4-only hits preserve their prior dispatch graph, waits, and complete-token parity.
Mixed hits retain device-only expert selection and exact route-conditioned byte/operation accounting.
Unsupported representations and inconsistent buffer extents remain fail-closed and use the qualified fallback.
not_qualified: A mixed-representation sealed Math-Preserve complete token has not run because the MOP clearance gate remains closed.
Route reuse on the sealed artifact has not been measured.
A multi-route associative lease is not admitted.
No sustained 2K/8K/32K, latency, TPS, memory-pressure, swap, or thermal promotion is claimed.
qualification.next_boundary: After MOP clearance, profile the sealed mixed route and its reuse distribution; preserve the one-route policy unless measured misses justify a bounded associative lease.
